# Secrets (names only)

Values never go in the repo, `_claude/`, `_data`, `/projects`, chat or this kit. The new account asks Brett for each
one and stores it where the table says.

| Name | Where it goes | What it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AXF_TOKEN` | console env (.axf-console/env) + your shell for .mcp.json | Dev Console token (API, /mcp, plugin routes). |
| `GITHUB_TOKEN` | console secrets / env | Fine-grained token for MossesX repos: Contents + Actions + Pull requests write. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | ~/.anthropic-key (0600) via claude-pick, or console AI assistant profile | Only when using an API key instead of the Claude plan. |
| `AXHUB_TOKEN` | ~/.config/axhub/token (claude-sync login) | axHub MCP bearer for claude-sync and changes.mjs. |
| `HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN` | axHub vault (hostinger-token) / console secrets | Hostinger API (VPS, DNS). |
| `COOLIFY_TOKEN` | console secrets | Coolify API. |
| `AXF_WALL_SECRET` | .axf-console/wall-secret = AXHUB_WALL_SECRET on the hub | axHub wall signature (made by the installer). |
| `ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE` | GitHub Actions secret | Stable debug signing key for app APKs (base64). |
